terminals.name: site
terminals.description: Regenerate the static site from data/plugins/*.yml and serve docs/ at http://localhost:8080. Rebuild manually with `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs && SKIP_PUBLISH_CHECKS=1 node scripts/build-site.mjs`.
terminals.command: SKIP_PUBLISH_CHECKS=1 node scripts/build-site.mjs && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory docs
